records.explanation: Bd3 dropped your Win% from 58 to 52. records.reply_line_san: 10...Nxg4 11. cxd5 Nb4 12. Be2 Nc2+ 13. Kd1 Nxa1 14. Bxg4 h5 15. Bf3
records.rule: reply Nxg4 is a capture; net material -9 (before your move) at the end of Stockfish's line (10 plies), -7 vs its best line
records.explanation: Qxg4 hung material: you end -9 in material. In Stockfish's lines, Bh4 (+2.1) gives up a bishop for a pawn; your Qxg4 (-9.2) gives up the queen and a rook for a knight and two pawns. Bh4 pins the knight on f6 to the queen on d8. Your Qxg4 takes the pawn on g4; Stockfish answers Nxg4, which takes the queen on g4.
